mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW (REVIEW_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REVIEWER_NO, REVIEWEE_NO, RATING, CONTENT) VALUES (REVIEW_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{reviewerNo}, #{revieweeNo}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND REVIEWER_NO = #{reviewerNo}

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.REVIEWER_NO, R.REVIEWEE_NO, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.REG_DATE, COALESCE(MP.NICKNAME, U.NAME) AS REVIEWER_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TITLE FROM REVIEW R JOIN USERS U ON R.REVIEWER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MP ON R.REVIEWER_NO = MP.USER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.REVIEWEE_NO = #{revieweeNo} ORDER BY R.REG_DATE DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.USER_NO AS SELLER_NO, P.BUYER_NO, PF.FILE_PATH AS IMG_PATH, COALESCE(MP.NICKNAME, U.NAME) AS SELLER_NAME FROM PRODUCT P JOIN USERS U ON P.USER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MP ON P.USER_NO = MP.USER_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE PF ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PF.PRODUCT_ID AND PF.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND P.TRADE_STATUS = 'SOLD' AND P.BUYER_NO = #{buyerNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEWEE_NO = #{revieweeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE MY_USER_PAGE SET TEMPERATURE = ROUND( GREATEST(0, LEAST(99.9, NVL(TEMPERATURE, 36.5) + CASE #{rating} WHEN 5 THEN 0.2 WHEN 4 THEN 0.1 WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN -0.1 WHEN 1 THEN -0.2 ELSE 0 END )), 1) WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
